description: All-in-one 1-call Pre-Sign Firewall across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, and Solana (100 free calls/day/IP). In one pass, recursively unwraps Multicall3/Uniswap Universal Router/Safe calldata or EIP-712 Permits or Solana wire txs, runs stateful eth_simulateV1 / Solana simulateTransaction with asset balance diffs, and automatically scans all touched token contracts for honeypots, taxes, and Token-2022 permanent delegates. Returns one deterministic recommendedAgentAction (EXECUTE_SAFE / CAUTION_HIGH_RISK / ABORT_*).

to.description: Target contract 0x address or Solana mint

transaction.description: Optional Base64/Base58 serialized Solana transaction to decode and simulate

transactions.description: Optional ordered multi-tx bundle [{ to, data, value }]

typedData.description: Optional EIP-712 typedData object (Permit, Permit2, Seaport, SafeTx) to audit before signing

name: nullclear_preflight_guard
